agentUpdateInstructions: From 0.2.0: stop local dev with rer dev --stop and export a private archive before updating. Run git pull in the existing checkout, then rer dev locally or rer deploy from the original deploying checkout for a hosted installation. This patch adds no product migrations or contract changes. Preserve the existing database, local settings, project keys and deployment receipts; do not reset or restore into the populated installation. Local dev opens through its private RER_OPEN owner entry and suppresses mail. Dev-created ingest/deploy keys work locally within their project; deployed installations refuse every dev-created key. Archives exclude project grants, so restored installations need fresh keys. Managed hosting supplies the RER mail relay; Free and Assisted hosting retain their configured provider. The application pins rer 0.2.24. SDK 0.2.0 remains unpublished on npm and is not published by this app release.
publicReleaseNotes: Spool 0.2.1 fixes local capture and source-map admission, hardens repository-scoped fix grants, and supports RER Managed mail with safe owner login hints. Local development suppresses mail and opens through its private RER_OPEN owner entry. No product migrations or contract changes. Product screenshot: .github/assets/release/spool-0.2.1-issues-1440.png (1440 x 900), showing the current Spool Dev app with synthetic Cedar Dispatch evidence captured through the real SDK, source-mapped and regressed in a later registered release. This screenshot is a local product capture, not a hosted or demo acceptance claim. The app release does not publish the SDK.
